# netbox_data_file (Data Source)

Retrieves a single data file from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_data_file" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "data_file_id" {
  value = data.netbox_data_file.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hash` (String) The hash of the data file.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the data file.
- `path` (String) The path of the data file.
- `size` (Number) The size of the data file.
- `source_id` (Number) The ID of the source associated with the data file.

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String) When the data file was last changed.
